verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs describe its own command-line entry points: you can create a first agent with a single command, and another command scaffolds an agent harness with workspace, shell tools, memory and schedules. A community user also completed the quickstart. However, the evidence never names a CLI, documents its commands, or shows it supporting AI-native workflows beyond scaffolding. missing for 10: an explicitly named and documented official CLI with a command reference, CLI coverage beyond project and agent scaffolding (e.g. dev, build, deploy), and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Create your first agent with a single command and start building.
Run this command to create a general-purpose agent harness with a local workspace, shell tools, memory, task tracking, web access, and recurring schedules.
A user ran through the quickstart and built a chat agent.
